fact: The CNT reported that on 20 June 2024 its commissions debated a bill to establish the Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel, an authority the 2016 cybersecurity and personal data protection law provides for, with members' designation and mandates still contested and plenary adoption pending.

The law defines an Autorité de Protection and gives it functions (declarations and authorisations, transfer approval, investigation, guidelines) but has processing declarations go to the competent authority 'designated by regulation' (Art. 5); it names no constituted body or appointed members (document published 2016-07).
system: Loi L/2016/037/AN relative à la cybersécurité et la protection des données à caractère personnel
